描述_EN: his cult, widespread in china by the mid 6th century, had a special popular appeal; buddhist believers were promised to enter his paradise simply by repeating his name with devotion.here he sits cross-legged on a lotus throne. this figure represents amitabha, the buddha of compassion, who presides over the western or pure land paradise. his right arm is missing from the elbow, but his hand may well have been held in wuweiyin (abhayamudra) position, the gesture of reassurance.
描述_ZN: his cult, widespread in china by the mid 6th century, had a special popular appeal; buddhist believers were promised to enter his paradise simply by repeating his name with devotion.here he sits cross-legged on a lotus throne. 此图代表阿弥陀佛，慈悲的菩萨，他主持西方或净土的天堂。 他的右臂从肘部开始就不见了，但他的手很可能是以wuweiyin（abhayamudra）的姿势握着的，这是一种放心的姿态。
